reading.title: Text 1
reading.en_title: The grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon has landed a scholarly…
reading.cn_title: 戏剧化教学对儿童语言与情感发展的促进作用
reading.topic: 戏剧化教学对儿童语言与情感发展的促进作用
reading.intro: 本篇主题：戏剧化教学对儿童语言与情感发展的促进作用。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: The grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon has landed a scholarly punch after groundbreaking research showed that Shakespeare does benefit children’s literacy and emotional development. But only if you act him out.
paragraphs.zh: 一项开创性研究表明，莎士比亚确实有助于提升儿童的读写能力和情感发展，这让这位来自埃文河畔斯特拉特福的文法学校少年在学术上“打出了一记重拳”。 但前提是，你得把莎士比亚的作品真正表演出来。

paragraphs.en: A study found that a “rehearsal room” approach to teaching Shakespeare broadened children’s vocabulary and the complexity of their writing as well as their emotional literacy. “The research shows that the way actors work makes a big difference to the way children use language and also how they think about themselves,” Jacqui O’Hanlon of the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC), which commissioned the study, said.
paragraphs.zh: 一项研究发现，以“排练室”方式教授莎士比亚，不仅拓展了儿童的词汇量，提升了其写作的复杂程度，也增强了他们的情感素养。 委托开展这项研究的皇家莎士比亚剧团（RSC）的杰姬·奥汉隆说：“研究表明，演员的工作方式会显著影响儿童运用语言的方式，也会影响他们如何看待自己。”

paragraphs.en: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils — aged nine and ten — at 45 state primary schools that had not been “previously exposed to RSC pedagogy.” They were split into target and control groups and asked to write, for example, a message in a bottle as Ferdinand following the shipwreck in *The Tempest*. The target group were given a 30-minute drama-based activity to accompany the passage.
paragraphs.zh: 这项随机对照试验涉及 45 所公立小学的数百名五年级学生，他们年龄为九至十岁，此前从未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团的教学法。 学生被分为实验组和对照组，并被要求完成写作任务，例如以《暴风雨》中遭遇海难后的费迪南德的身份，写一封装在瓶中的信。 实验组还围绕这段文本参加了一项 30 分钟的戏剧活动。

paragraphs.en: The peer-reviewed results showed that the target group of pupils drew on a wider vocabulary, used words “classed as more sophisticated or rarer”, and wrote at greater length. They also “appear to be more comfortable writing in role...while [control] pupils imagine how they themselves would react to being shipwrecked, [target] children put themselves in the shoes of a literary character and express that character’s emotion”. The *Time to Act* study, which is published by the RSC this week, also found that while control pupils relied on “desert island clichés” such as palm trees, target pupils were “more expansive [giving] a broader picture of the sky, the sea and the atmospheric conditions”.
paragraphs.zh: 经同行评审的结果显示，实验组学生使用的词汇范围更广，会采用“被归为更复杂或更少见”的词语，而且写作篇幅也更长。 实验组学生似乎也“更能自如地以角色身份写作……对照组学生想象的是自己遭遇海难时会作何反应，而实验组儿童则设身处地代入某个文学人物，并表达该人物的情感”。 皇家莎士比亚剧团于本周发布的《行动时刻》研究还发现，对照组学生依赖棕榈树之类的“荒岛套话”，而实验组学生的描写则“更加铺陈开阔，[呈现出]天空、海洋和天气状况的更完整画面”。

paragraphs.en: O’Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the “emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children’s writing” and that they were “more resilient in their writing, more hopeful”. She added “The emotional understanding was very evident and it is probably related to the [rehearsal room process] where you are used to trying to imagine your way through. They were comfortable in describing different emotional states and part of what you do in drama is put yourself in different shoes.” The study showed the importance of embedding arts in education, she said.
paragraphs.zh: 奥汉隆说，最令她惊讶的是“实验组儿童写作中明显体现出的情感素养”，以及他们的文字表现得“更坚韧、更有希望”。 她补充说：“这种情感理解表现得非常明显，它很可能与‘排练室过程’有关；在这一过程中，学生习惯于凭借想象进入并经历整个情境。 他们能够自如地描述不同的情绪状态，而戏剧活动的一部分，正是让自己站到不同人物的立场上。” 她表示，这项研究表明，将艺术融入教育十分重要。

paragraphs.en: But could the results be replicated with any old dramatist? O’Hanlon said more research would be needed but suggested that Shakespeare’s use of 20,000 words, compared with the everyday 2,000 words, gave a “massive expansion of language into children’s lives”, which was combined with children “using their whole bodies to bring words to life”.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，随便换一位旧时剧作家，也能取得同样的结果吗？ 奥汉隆说，这还需要更多研究，但她指出，莎士比亚使用约 20,000 个词，而日常用词仅约 2,000 个，这能让儿童生活中的语言得到“大幅拓展”；与此同时，儿童还会“调动整个身体，让词语鲜活起来”。

questions.stem: The “rehearsal room” approach requires pupils to ____
options: rewrite the lines from Shakespeare.
watch RSC actors’ performances.
play the roles in Shakespeare.
study drama under RSC artists.
questions.explain:
正确项：play the roles in Shakespeare. act him out 并非研究莎士比亚的生平，而是把他的戏剧演出来，即让学生扮演莎士比亚作品中的角色。后文的 writing in role 和 put themselves in the shoes of a literary character 进一步印证了这种参与式表演。
其他选项：A. rewrite the lines from Shakespeare.：实验中的写作任务是以人物身份创作瓶中信，并不是改写莎士比亚的台词，属于偷换活动内容。；B. watch RSC actors’ performances.：原文强调学生像演员一样亲身表演，没有提到观看皇家莎士比亚剧团演员的演出，属于无中生有。；D. study drama under RSC artists.：RSC 委托了研究，但原文未说学生接受 RSC 艺术家的直接指导，属于主体与教学关系的臆造。
questions.evidence: But only if you act him out.

questions.stem: The study divided the pupils into two groups to find whether ____
options: the change in instruction enhances learning outcomes.
expanding vocabulary helps develop reading fluency.
emotion affects understanding of sophisticated works.
the classroom activity stimulates interest in the arts.
questions.explain:
正确项：the change in instruction enhances learning outcomes. 两组完成相同的写作任务，区别是实验组增加了 30 分钟戏剧活动；随后实验组在词汇范围、用词难度和篇幅上表现更好。因此分组是为了检验教学方式的改变能否提升学习成果。
其他选项：B. expanding vocabulary helps develop reading fluency.：研究记录了写作词汇和篇幅的变化，并未测量阅读流利度，也没有把词汇拓展设为自变量。；C. emotion affects understanding of sophisticated works.：原文考察的是戏剧教学对写作与情感素养的影响，不是情绪对理解复杂作品的影响，因果方向和研究对象均被替换。；D. the classroom activity stimulates interest in the arts.：文章最终肯定艺术教育的重要性，但实验没有测量学生对艺术的兴趣，属于无中生有。
questions.evidence:
They were split into target and control groups and asked to write, for example, a message in a bottle as Ferdinand following the shipwreck in *The Tempest*.
The target group were given a 30-minute drama-based activity to accompany the passage.
The peer-reviewed results showed that the target group of pupils drew on a wider vocabulary, used words “classed as more sophisticated or rarer”, and wrote at greater length.

questions.stem: Control pupils’ reliance on “desert island clichés” shows their ____
options: weakness in description.
omission of small details.
casual style of writing.
preference for big words.
questions.explain:
正确项：weakness in description. 对照组只会使用棕榈树等荒岛套话，而实验组能更充分地描写天空、海洋和天气。两者的直接对比表明，对照组的问题是描写单一、贫乏，即描述能力较弱。
其他选项：B. omission of small details.：原文说实验组描写的范围更广，不是专门强调对照组遗漏了“细小细节”；该项把整体描写贫乏窄化为细节缺失。；C. casual style of writing.：clichés 指内容陈旧、刻板，不等于文体随意；原文没有评价其正式或非正式程度。；D. preference for big words.：使用更复杂、更少见词语的是实验组，而非依赖套话的对照组，属于张冠李戴。
questions.evidence: The *Time to Act* study, which is published by the RSC this week, also found that while control pupils relied on “desert island clichés” such as palm trees, target pupils were “more expansive [giving] a broader picture of the sky, the sea and the atmospheric conditions”.

questions.stem: What can promote children’s emotional literacy according to O’Hanlon?
options: Writing in an imaginative manner.
Identifying with literary characters.
Drawing inspiration from nature.
Concentrating on real-life situations.
questions.explain:
正确项：Identifying with literary characters. 奥汉隆把情感理解的提升归因于排练过程中对情境的想象，以及“站到不同人物的立场上”。这正是认同并代入文学人物，即 identifying with literary characters。
其他选项：A. Writing in an imaginative manner.：想象是角色代入的手段，但原文强调的是想象自己身处人物境遇，而非泛指采用富有想象力的写作方式，表述过于宽泛。；C. Drawing inspiration from nature.：天空、海洋和天气只是写作结果中的描写内容，原文没有说从自然中获取灵感能提升情感素养。；D. Concentrating on real-life situations.：学生需要进入戏剧人物和虚构情境，该项强调现实生活，方向与原文相反。
questions.evidence:
She added “The emotional understanding was very evident and it is probably related to the [rehearsal room process] where you are used to trying to imagine your way through.
They were comfortable in describing different emotional states and part of what you do in drama is put yourself in different shoes.”

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ____
options: the new teaching method may work best with Shakespeare.
the language of Shakespeare may be formidable for pupils.
other old dramatists may be included in primary education.
pupils may be reluctant to work on other old dramatists.
questions.explain:
正确项：the new teaching method may work best with Shakespeare. 面对“换成任何剧作家能否复现结果”的问题，奥汉隆没有直接肯定，而是突出莎士比亚约 20,000 个词的语言资源，并说明其与全身表演结合能大幅拓展儿童语言。这暗示该方法可能在教授莎士比亚时效果最佳。
其他选项：B. the language of Shakespeare may be formidable for pupils.：原文把庞大词汇量视为拓展儿童语言的优势，并未说它令学生望而生畏，态度与原文相反。；C. other old dramatists may be included in primary education.：末段只说其他剧作家能否产生同样效果尚需研究，没有提出把他们纳入小学教育，属于过度推断。；D. pupils may be reluctant to work on other old dramatists.：文中没有讨论学生对其他剧作家的意愿或抗拒程度，属于无中生有。
questions.evidence:
But could the results be replicated with any old dramatist?
O’Hanlon said more research would be needed but suggested that Shakespeare’s use of 20,000 words, compared with the everyday 2,000 words, gave a “massive expansion of language into children’s lives”, which was combined with children “using their whole bodies to bring words to life”.

reading.title: Text 2
reading.en_title: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale bac…
reading.cn_title: 科研活动的碳排放与绿色转型
reading.topic: 科研活动的碳排放与绿色转型
reading.intro: 本篇主题：科研活动的碳排放与绿色转型。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions. The crisis is here, they said, and we need to cut back on our energy-intensive modelling. At the very least, we need to make our energy use far more sustainable.
paragraphs.zh: 最近得知有些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我深感震惊。 他们说，危机已经来临，我们必须减少高耗能的建模工作。 至少，我们需要让能源使用变得可持续得多。

paragraphs.en: It is unarguable that our laboratories, scientific instruments, rockets and satellites — the tools we scientists need to measure the planet’s pulse — demand significant amounts of energy both in their construction and operation. And it is equally true that science’s unrelenting appetite for information has caused a mushrooming of energy-intensive data centres around the world. According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 percent of the world’s electricity.
paragraphs.zh: 无可争辩的是，我们的实验室、科学仪器、火箭和卫星——这些是科学家监测地球“脉搏”所必需的工具——无论在建造阶段还是运行阶段，都需要消耗大量能源。 同样不可否认的是，科学对信息永无止境的需求，导致高耗能数据中心在世界各地迅速涌现。 据国际能源署统计，这些数据中心目前消耗全球约 1% 的电力。

paragraphs.en: However, this is a price we must pay for understanding the world. How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can’t track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it’s coming from and who’s producing it? The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这是我们为了认识世界而必须付出的代价。 如果我们无法追踪大气中二氧化碳的总量、来源以及排放者，又怎能向决策者说明减少碳排放的最佳方式呢？ 技术研究产生的这些碳排放是值得付出的：归根结底，这类研究将守护我们星球的未来。

paragraphs.en: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation. But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. It is all too easy to feel paralysed in the face of daunting problems such as climate change and to do nothing. But then I think of a friend’s daughter who turned her fears into action: she became a wind energy engineer and now thrives on delivering renewable energy, limiting emissions.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家有时很难把这一道理讲清楚，因为我们的工作十分复杂，往往在公众视野之外进行，也并不总是容易理解或解释。 但如果人类要解决最重大的难题，证明科学确有成效将至关重要。 面对气候变化等令人生畏的难题，人很容易陷入无力感，最终什么也不做。 但这时，我会想到一位朋友的女儿。她把恐惧转化成了行动：她成为一名风能工程师，如今投身于输送可再生能源、限制碳排放，并从中获得成长与满足。

paragraphs.en: Recognising the hope that science and engineering can bring was the impetus behind the creation of the Millennium Technology Prize, which is now entering its 20th year as a celebration of human ingenuity. One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world’s solar panels. Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world’s carbon emissions.
paragraphs.zh: 认识到科学与工程能够带来希望，正是设立“千年技术奖”的推动力；如今，该奖项即将迈入第 20 个年头，持续礼赞人类的创造才智。 该奖项往届得主之一、澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的马丁·格林教授，是“钝化发射极和背面电池”（PERC）技术的发明者；如今，全球大多数太阳能电池板都采用了这项技术。 多亏他的发明，我们才真正有机会降低全球碳排放。

paragraphs.en: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence. A great example of this is Europe’s largest supercomputer, LUMI in Finland, which is astonishingly carbon-negative. Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家、技术专家和工程师每天都在探索利用可再生能源的新方式，并开发各种技术，不仅让我们更聪明地使用电力，也用电力驱动人类的智能运算。 这方面的杰出范例是位于芬兰、欧洲规模最大的超级计算机 LUMI；令人惊叹的是，它实现了“负碳排放”。 LUMI 建在一座旧造纸厂内，由附近河流提供电力，其远程供热还为周边卡亚尼镇的居民送去温暖。

paragraphs.en: If the world is to meet its net-zero ambitions, we must think hard about how we can deliver sustainable computing and deliver more LUMIs.
paragraphs.zh: 如果世界要实现净零排放目标，我们就必须认真思考如何推动可持续计算，并建设更多像 LUMI 这样的超级计算机。

questions.stem: The author expressed great surprise at some scientists’ ____
options: unwillingness to cut carbon emissions.
intention to reduce their research.
suspicions about sustainable energy.
waste of electricity in their projects.
questions.explain:
正确项：intention to reduce their research. was shocked 对应题干的 expressed great surprise，want to scale back their research 则同义改写为“打算减少研究”，信息逐项对应。
其他选项：A. unwillingness to cut carbon emissions.：这些科学家正是为了减少排放才打算缩减研究，并非“不愿减排”，与原文相反。；C. suspicions about sustainable energy.：他们主张提高能源使用的可持续性，没有怀疑可持续能源，属于无中生有。；D. waste of electricity in their projects.：原文承认科研耗能，却没有指责科学家浪费电力；“高耗能”不等于“浪费”。
questions.evidence: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.

questions.stem: The author believes that carbon emissions from research ____
options: have caused grave consequences.
have aroused groundless worries.
are hard to handle at present.
are justifiable in the long run.
questions.explain:
正确项：are justifiable in the long run. 作者把科研排放称为认识世界“必须付出的代价”，并认为它们 are well spent，因为科研最终会守护地球未来。也就是说，从长期收益看，这些排放具有正当性。
其他选项：A. have caused grave consequences.：文章承认科研耗能，但未说其排放已经造成严重后果；核心判断反而是长期收益能够证明这项成本值得。；B. have aroused groundless worries.：作者没有否认气候危机或说担忧毫无根据，只反对以缩减研究作为回应，属于态度扩大。；C. are hard to handle at present.：文中说科研工作复杂、难以解释，并非科研排放当前难以处理，混淆了“科研传播难”与“排放治理难”。
questions.evidence:
However, this is a price we must pay for understanding the world.
The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.

questions.stem: The example of Green in Paragraph 5 is used to illustrate ____
options: the achievements of great scientists.
the urgency of addressing climate change.
the rewards of scientific endeavours.
the value of fostering human ingenuity.
questions.explain:
正确项：the rewards of scientific endeavours. 格林的科研成果已应用于全球大多数太阳能电池板，并让降低全球碳排放成为现实可能。这一例子展示的是科学努力带来的实际回报与社会收益，而不仅是他个人获奖。
其他选项：A. the achievements of great scientists.：格林确实取得重大成就，但作者落脚于其发明带来的减排机会；该项停留在人物成就表面，未概括例子的论证作用。；B. the urgency of addressing climate change.：例子说明技术能够解决问题，没有突出时间紧迫性，属于偏离例证重点。；D. the value of fostering human ingenuity.：human ingenuity 用来说明奖项所礼赞的对象，格林案例具体证明的是科学创造产生了可应用的回报；“培养创造力”这一教育或制度行为并未展开。
questions.evidence:
Recognising the hope that science and engineering can bring was the impetus behind the creation of the Millennium Technology Prize, which is now entering its 20th year as a celebration of human ingenuity.
One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world’s solar panels.
Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world’s carbon emissions.

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last two paragraphs that LUMI ____
options: is a model of sustainability efforts.
is a triumph against energy shortage.
owes much to global net-zero initiatives.
aims to explore the power of intelligence.
questions.explain:
正确项：is a model of sustainability efforts. LUMI 达到负碳运行，利用旧造纸厂、附近河流和供热系统形成能源循环；作者还呼吁建设更多 LUMI。它因此是可持续计算实践的示范模式。
其他选项：B. is a triumph against energy shortage.：文中讨论的是碳排放和能源利用方式，没有说当地面临能源短缺，更未把 LUMI 描述为战胜短缺的成果。；C. owes much to global net-zero initiatives.：原文说推广 LUMI 有助于世界实现净零目标，不是全球净零行动促成了 LUMI，属于因果倒置。；D. aims to explore the power of intelligence.：power our intelligence 指用能源驱动智能计算；作者把 LUMI 用作可持续供能的例子，并未说它的目标是探索智能的力量，属于字面拼接。
questions.evidence:
A great example of this is Europe’s largest supercomputer, LUMI in Finland, which is astonishingly carbon-negative.
Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
If the world is to meet its net-zero ambitions, we must think hard about how we can deliver sustainable computing and deliver more LUMIs.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements would the author agree with?
options: Emission-free modelling demands extra funding.
The need for supercomputers is difficult to meet.
Energy-intensive research work is inevitable.
The goals of researchers ought to be realistic.
questions.explain:
正确项：Energy-intensive research work is inevitable. 科研所必需的实验室、仪器、火箭和卫星在建造与运行中都需要大量能源，作者称这是认识世界“必须付出的代价”。因此，一定程度的高耗能科研不可避免，正确方向是提高其可持续性，而非停止研究。
其他选项：A. Emission-free modelling demands extra funding.：文章没有讨论“零排放建模”，也没有涉及额外经费需求，两个信息均属无中生有。；B. The need for supercomputers is difficult to meet.：作者呼吁建设更多 LUMI，但没有说超级计算机需求难以满足；讨论重点是如何实现可持续计算。；D. The goals of researchers ought to be realistic.：文中没有批评研究目标不切实际，也未提出调整目标；作者反而强调科研应继续应对重大挑战。
questions.evidence:
It is unarguable that our laboratories, scientific instruments, rockets and satellites — the tools we scientists need to measure the planet’s pulse — demand significant amounts of energy both in their construction and operation.
However, this is a price we must pay for understanding the world.

reading.title: Text 3
reading.en_title: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has s…
reading.cn_title: 流媒体时代的数字盗版治理
reading.topic: 流媒体时代的数字盗版治理
reading.intro: 本篇主题：流媒体时代的数字盗版治理。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was. But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 自从传统好莱坞在网飞擅长的流媒体领域与之正面竞争以来，它始终难以从流媒体业务中获利；迪士尼+、Peacock 和 Paramount+ 等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，由此引发担忧：这些服务可能永远无法达到传统有线电视昔日的盈利水平。 然而，流媒体时代却让一群意料之外的赢家获益匪浅：盗版者用软件在数秒内从正规在线视频平台抓取电影或电视剧，再把这些作品放到自己的非法服务平台上；这些平台每年通过广告和订阅收入约 20 亿美元。

paragraphs.en: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that’s working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
paragraphs.zh: 美国电影协会（MPA）表示，由于无需承担视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近 90%。该协会是代表好莱坞制片公司的行业组织，正努力打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。

paragraphs.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads. But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center. The global impact is about $71 billion annually.
paragraphs.zh: 起初，网飞等正规在线业务的兴起实际上帮助遏制了数字盗版；此前，数字盗版主要依赖文件上传。 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件分享的盗版行为，每年使美国经济损失约 300 亿美元收入和约 25 万个就业岗位。 在全球范围内，盗版每年造成的经济影响约为 710 亿美元。

paragraphs.en: “The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations,” says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA. “This is organized crime.” Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy. In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.
paragraphs.zh: 美国电影协会首席执行官查理·里夫金说：“那些盗取我们的电影和电视节目、经营盗版网站的人，并不是什么家庭式小作坊。” “这是有组织犯罪。” 里夫金于 2017 年加入美国电影协会；五年前，该协会曾试图在好莱坞与硅谷之间凝聚共识，以推动国会通过打击网络盗版的立法，但最终未能成功。 2017 年，该协会成立了“创意与娱乐联盟”（ACE）。这是一支执法工作组，约有 100 名调查人员在全球开展行动，协助当地执法部门逮捕流媒体盗版者。

paragraphs.en: ACE says it’s helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA’s support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyright material a serious crime.
paragraphs.zh: ACE 表示，它已帮助把北美非法流媒体服务的数量从 2018 年的 1,400 多个压缩至 126 个；这一成果也部分得益于美国电影协会对 2020 年一项联邦法律的支持，该法律把大规模传播版权内容的流媒体盗版行为列为严重犯罪。

paragraphs.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services’ cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years. “While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline,” says analyst Steve Hawley.
paragraphs.zh: 咨询公司 Parks Associates 预测，从 2022 年开始累计计算，未来两年美国正规流媒体服务因盗版造成的损失将达到 1,130 亿美元。 分析师史蒂夫·霍利说：“尽管有人乐观地认为，新出现的应对措施和最佳实践或许能让盗版活动到 2027 年开始趋于平稳，但利益相关方对于它究竟何时才会开始下降，并没有一致看法。”

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, legitimate streaming services ____
options: have drawn lessons from Hollywood.
have surpassed cable in revenue.
are unpopular with advertisers.
are confronted with a real threat.
questions.explain:
正确项：are confronted with a real threat. 正规平台本已每年亏损数十亿美元，盗版者又能在数秒内抓取其内容并从中年入约 20 亿美元。盗版由此构成直接且真实的商业威胁。
其他选项：A. have drawn lessons from Hollywood.：原文是传统好莱坞进入网飞擅长的流媒体领域竞争，没有说流媒体服务向好莱坞吸取经验，主体关系倒置。；B. have surpassed cable in revenue.：文章担忧流媒体可能永远达不到有线电视昔日的盈利水平，与“已经超过”相反。；C. are unpopular with advertisers.：广告是盗版平台的收入来源之一，文中并未评价广告商是否喜欢正规平台，属于无中生有。
questions.evidence:
Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.

questions.stem: It can be learned that streamers like Netflix ____
options: played a part in the fight against illegal file-sharing.
reaped benefits from the war with digital pirates.
promised to become big job creators in the US.
used to collaborate with file-uploading platforms.
questions.explain:
正确项：played a part in the fight against illegal file-sharing. 网飞等正规在线业务的兴起曾帮助 curb digital piracy，而当时的盗版主要依靠文件上传，即非法文件分享。因此它们曾在反非法文件分享中发挥作用。
其他选项：B. reaped benefits from the war with digital pirates.：获得巨额收益的是盗版平台，正规流媒体反而承受损失，属于张冠李戴。；C. promised to become big job creators in the US.：文中的 25 万个岗位是盗版造成的就业损失，没有任何平台承诺创造大量岗位。；D. used to collaborate with file-uploading platforms.：正规服务的兴起遏制了基于文件上传的盗版，并非与其合作，关系与原文相反。
questions.evidence: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 4 that the MPA ____
options: was denied cooperation by Silicon Valley.
led a national protest against online piracy.
was urged to form an enforcement task force.
failed to win support from local authorities.
questions.explain:
正确项：was denied cooperation by Silicon Valley. MPA 代表好莱坞利益；它未能在好莱坞与硅谷之间形成推动反盗版立法的共识，说明硅谷方面没有给予所需合作。failed to build consensus 是题项 was denied cooperation 的推断依据。
其他选项：B. led a national protest against online piracy.：MPA 尝试推动国会立法，后来成立执法工作组；原文没有全国性抗议活动。；C. was urged to form an enforcement task force.：文章只说 MPA 于 2017 年成立 ACE，没有说这一行动受谁敦促，属于补写原因。；D. failed to win support from local authorities.：ACE 的职责正是协助当地执法部门抓捕盗版者，文中未说地方当局拒绝支持；失败的合作发生在好莱坞与硅谷之间。
questions.evidence: Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy.

questions.stem: According to Hawley, digital piracy ____
options: cannot be checked in spite of new legislation.
will possibly overwhelm legitimate streamers.
is unlikely to diminish in the near future.
has been underestimated by some analysts.
questions.explain:
正确项：is unlikely to diminish in the near future. 霍利区分了 plateau 与 decline：到 2027 年盗版或许只是不再增长，而利益相关方甚至不确定它何时才会下降。因此，盗版在近期不太可能真正减少。
其他选项：A. cannot be checked in spite of new legislation.：联邦法律和 ACE 已使北美非法平台数量大幅下降，说明盗版能够受到遏制；霍利也只是谨慎判断其何时下降，并未说绝对无法控制。；B. will possibly overwhelm legitimate streamers.：文中预测正规平台损失巨大，但没有说盗版可能彻底压垮它们，属于程度扩大。；D. has been underestimated by some analysts.：霍利谈的是未来走势缺乏共识，没有评价其他分析师低估盗版，属于无中生有。
questions.evidence: “While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline,” says analyst Steve Hawley.

questions.stem: Which of the following is emphasized in the text?
options: The need to coordinate anti-piracy action.
The criminal nature of copyright violation.
The prospect of eliminating online piracy.
The economic harm from illegal streaming.
questions.explain:
正确项：The economic harm from illegal streaming. 文章反复给出盗版平台 20 亿美元收入、美国每年 300 亿美元及 25 万个岗位损失、全球 710 亿美元影响和未来 1,130 亿美元累计损失。贯穿全文并被多组数据强化的是非法流媒体造成的经济危害。
其他选项：A. The need to coordinate anti-piracy action.：好莱坞、硅谷、ACE 与地方当局之间的协作是治理过程的一部分，但文章没有把“需要协调”作为反复强调的中心。；B. The criminal nature of copyright violation.：里夫金确实称盗版为有组织犯罪，联邦法也将大规模盗播定为重罪，但这只是执法背景；全文更密集地呈现其经济损失。；C. The prospect of eliminating online piracy.：结尾指出各方不知盗版何时下降，更未谈彻底消除；该项与作者的谨慎判断相反。
questions.evidence:
But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center.
The global impact is about $71 billion annually.

reading.title: Text 4
reading.en_title: Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past:…
reading.cn_title: 数字资料长期保存所面临的技术与制度难题
reading.topic: 数字资料长期保存所面临的技术与制度难题
reading.intro: 本篇主题：数字资料长期保存所面临的技术与制度难题。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World’s Fair, the ephemera of history. Yet these objects aren’t truly ephemeral, because they’re still here, decades, even centuries later. Why? Because they’re tangible.
paragraphs.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会遇见来自过去的物件：照片、书信、一份介绍 1964-1965 年世界博览会辛克莱恐龙展的宣传册——这些都是历史上原本短暂易逝的资料。 然而，这些物件其实并非真正转瞬即逝，因为几十年、甚至几百年后，它们依然存在。 为什么？ 因为它们是有形的实物。

paragraphs.en: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation? For millennia, we’ve known what we’ve known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators’ neglect. The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information. At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on. Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information. Thus, librarians digitize the tangible so that researchers the world over can quickly search and access their holdings. The result is an embarrassment of historical riches, which brings its own needle-and-haystack problems.
paragraphs.zh: 既然数字资料的制作者很少为其长期保存预作安排，你是否思考过这类无形格式，也就是数字信息，究竟有怎样的生命周期？ 数千年来，我们之所以能够了解过去，靠的是那些留存至今的实物；它们往往是在最初制作者疏于保存的情况下仍然幸存下来的。 实体物本身就是传递信息的媒介。 这些资料产生之初，人们并未尝试有意保存它们；然而，模拟材料仍有机会留存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。 长久以来，图书馆和档案馆一直肩负着信息整理、保存和开放利用的责任。 因此，图书馆员把实体资料数字化，使世界各地的研究者都能快速检索并获取馆藏内容。 其结果是历史资料丰富得令人不知如何取舍，而这种富足也带来了大海捞针般的检索难题。

paragraphs.en: Librarians’ selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cellphone and saying, “it’s all in here” as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today. Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained? Who curates what is preserved? When it comes to born-digital information, the terrifying answer can be: if not librarians and archivists, then no one. Digital information requires a great deal more care than analog.
paragraphs.zh: 图书馆员无私投入所创造的便利有时反而会对我们不利：用户举起手机说“这里面什么都有”，用普遍可获取的信息作为证据，认为今天的研究者已经不再那么需要图书馆。 然而，这种普遍可获取性究竟是如何实现的？也许更重要的是，它又是如何维持的？ 又是谁在筛选和整理那些被保存下来的内容？ 谈到原生数字信息，答案可能令人不安：如果图书馆员和档案管理员不来做，就再没有别人会做。 数字信息需要投入的维护远多于模拟资料。

paragraphs.en: Even when a digital object is preserved, it may only be the carrier that’s saved, not the information itself. As technology advances and a format becomes obsolete, the object is useless. Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this? Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replace analog.
paragraphs.zh: 即便一个数字对象被保存下来，留存的也可能只是存储载体，而不是信息本身。 随着技术发展、某种格式遭到淘汰，这个数字对象也就失去了用处。 你是否曾无助地盯着一张 ZIP 磁盘，心里想着：我怎样才能把里面的文件取出来？ 如果不持续迁移数字资料，历史学家就会被一种关于可见未来的噩梦搅得夜不能寐：当数字资料取代模拟资料后，历史记录会突然中断。

paragraphs.en: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I’d be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists. Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing, and preserving digital information for researchers current and future. Librarians are uniquely positioned to understand how end users seek and use information. Thus we play an integral role in identifying, preserving, and providing accessibility to digital artifacts so that, while future researchers may find the digital realm a challenging place to ply their trade, they won’t find it an impossible one.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏资料与数字资产展开的图书馆员，我同样承受着历史学家的这种夜间恐惧；如果我说目前已经存在一套全面的保存方案，那就是在撒谎。 不过，研究者仍可从一个事实中得到些许安慰：众多图书馆员正致力于发现、整理和保存数字信息，为当下及未来的研究者服务。 图书馆员处在独特而有利的位置，能够理解终端用户如何查找并使用信息。 因此，我们在识别、保存数字资料并使其可供利用方面发挥着不可或缺的作用；这样一来，未来的研究者即使会觉得数字世界是一个颇具挑战的研究场域，也不至于发现它根本无法开展工作。

questions.stem: The author mentions the artifacts from the past to ____
options: introduce the collection of antiques.
contrast them with everyday items.
bring up the issue of preservation.
comment on their historical value.
questions.explain:
正确项：bring up the issue of preservation. 作者先指出原本短暂使用的实体资料在几十年乃至几百年后仍然存在，随即追问数字信息的生命周期和长期保存安排。开篇史料的作用正是引出“资料如何留存”这一核心问题。
其他选项：A. introduce the collection of antiques.：古董店只是便于观察幸存实物的场景，文章并不介绍某一批古董藏品。；B. contrast them with everyday items.：作者对比的是实体资料与数字资料，不是历史物件与日常用品，比较对象错误。；D. comment on their historical value.：照片、书信和宣传册被称为历史资料，但作者没有评估其价值高低；关注点是它们为何能保存至今。
questions.evidence:
Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World’s Fair, the ephemera of history.
Yet these objects aren’t truly ephemeral, because they’re still here, decades, even centuries later.
Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?

questions.stem: Compared with digital objects, tangible artifacts ____
options: are less subject to their creators’ neglect.
convey information in a more direct way.
require more intentional preservation.
are less likely to suffer serious damage.
questions.explain:
正确项：convey information in a more direct way. 对实体资料而言，物件本身就是传递信息的媒介，无需把信息与另一个依赖设备和格式的载体分开。相较数字对象，它传递信息的方式更直接。
其他选项：A. are less subject to their creators’ neglect.：原文说许多实体资料“尽管受到制作者忽视”仍然幸存，不是说它们较少遭到忽视；把“能经受忽视”偷换成“较少被忽视”。；C. require more intentional preservation.：文章说实体资料在没有主动保存的情况下仍有机会幸存，而数字信息需要更多维护，该项方向相反。；D. are less likely to suffer serious damage.：原文没有比较两类资料遭受物理损坏的概率；重点是实体物可直接承载信息，而数字载体完好时内容也可能无法读取。
questions.evidence: The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, librarians’ work may result in ____
options: oversupply of materials.
undervaluation of libraries.
researchers’ underperformance.
users’ overreliance on technology.
questions.explain:
正确项：undervaluation of libraries. 图书馆员把资料整理得随处可得，用户因此误以为“一部手机里什么都有”，并把这种便利视为图书馆不再重要的证据。图书馆工作的成功反而可能造成对图书馆价值的低估。
其他选项：A. oversupply of materials.：上一段的 an embarrassment of historical riches 涉及资料过多和检索困难，但第三段讨论的是便利访问使图书馆被低估，段落定位不符。；C. researchers’ underperformance.：文中没有评价研究者表现下降，只描述他们对图书馆重要性的误判。；D. users’ overreliance on technology.：手机是用户声称信息普遍可得的象征；作者批评的是由此低估图书馆，而非用户对技术形成过度依赖。
questions.evidence:
Librarians’ selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cellphone and saying, “it’s all in here” as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?

questions.stem: The “ZIP disk” is cited as an example to show ____
options: the hazard of retrieving files through unusual means.
the infeasibility of constantly migrating digital assets.
the possibility of losing information in obsolete formats.
the inconvenience of storing information on analog devices.
questions.explain:
正确项：the possibility of losing information in obsolete formats. ZIP 磁盘这一载体可能依然完好，但随着专用格式和读取设备被淘汰，用户无法导出其中的文件，信息实际上就可能丢失。例子说明的是过时格式造成的信息不可访问风险。
其他选项：A. the hazard of retrieving files through unusual means.：原文没有描述采用非常规方式取文件的危险，而是根本不知道如何读取旧介质，重点在技术不兼容。；B. the infeasibility of constantly migrating digital assets.：作者说数字资料需要持续迁移，没有说迁移不可行；ZIP 磁盘说明的是不迁移可能造成的后果。；D. the inconvenience of storing information on analog devices.：ZIP 磁盘在文中是数字信息载体，问题也不是存储不便，而是格式过时后无法读取。
questions.evidence:
Even when a digital object is preserved, it may only be the carrier that’s saved, not the information itself.
As technology advances and a format becomes obsolete, the object is useless.
Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?

questions.stem: Which of the following statements best summarizes the text?
options: Hard work should be done to preserve artifacts.
Contributions of librarians should be recognized.
Accessing databases is essential to researchers.
Keeping digital historical records is a challenge.
questions.explain:
正确项：Keeping digital historical records is a challenge. 全文从实体资料能够自然幸存切入，逐层说明数字信息依赖格式与载体、需要持续迁移、可能造成历史断层，而且目前尚无全面保存方案。结尾虽肯定图书馆员的作用，仍把数字历史记录定位为一项长期挑战。
其他选项：A. Hard work should be done to preserve artifacts.：表述过于笼统，既未限定数字资料，也只泛泛主张“应努力”，没有概括格式淘汰、迁移和历史断层这一核心难题。；B. Contributions of librarians should be recognized.：文章确实解释图书馆员为何重要，但这是应对数字保存挑战的关键力量，不是全文最终要呼吁认可其贡献。；C. Accessing databases is essential to researchers.：文章讨论数字信息的长期保存与可访问性，并未把访问数据库作为研究者的核心需求，属于偷换概念。
questions.evidence:
Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replace analog.
As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I’d be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
Thus we play an integral role in identifying, preserving, and providing accessibility to digital artifacts so that, while future researchers may find the digital realm a challenging place to ply their trade, they won’t find it an impossible one.

sentences.en: The grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon has landed a scholarly punch after groundbreaking research showed that Shakespeare does benefit children’s literacy and emotional development.
sentences.core: The grammar school boy ... has landed a scholarly punch.
sentences.structure: from Stratford-upon-Avon 修饰 boy；after 引出原因兼时间背景；research showed that ... 中 that 引导宾语从句。
sentences.key: land a punch：本指“成功击中一拳”，此处借喻莎士比亚的教育价值获得了有力的学术证明。；grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon：以莎士比亚的故乡和少年经历代指莎士比亚本人。；groundbreaking research：开创性的研究。；does benefit：助动词 does 强调“确实有益”，回应人们对莎士比亚教育价值的疑问。
sentences.zh: 一项开创性研究表明，莎士比亚确实有助于提升儿童的读写能力和情感发展，这让这位来自埃文河畔斯特拉特福的文法学校少年在学术上“打出了一记重拳”。
sentences.tip: 句中真正受益的是 children，而获得学术支持的是被戏称为“文法学校少年”的莎士比亚。

sentences.en: But only if you act him out.
sentences.core: 这是省略句，完整逻辑为 Shakespeare benefits children only if you act him out.
sentences.structure: 见原句
sentences.key: act him out：此处不是单纯“模仿莎士比亚本人”，而是通过扮演其作品中的角色、排演其戏剧来学习。
sentences.zh: 但前提是，你得把莎士比亚的作品真正表演出来。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: A study found that a “rehearsal room” approach to teaching Shakespeare broadened children’s vocabulary and the complexity of their writing as well as their emotional literacy.
sentences.core: A study found that an approach broadened ...
sentences.structure: that 引导宾语从句；to teaching Shakespeare 修饰 approach；children’s vocabulary、the complexity of their writing 与 their emotional literacy 是教学法产生的三方面效果。
sentences.key: rehearsal room approach：借鉴演员排练过程、让学生亲身表演和体验角色的教学法。；emotional literacy：识别、理解并恰当表达情绪的能力，即“情感素养”。；as well as：连接并列成分，此处表示“除了……之外还……”。
sentences.zh: 一项研究发现，以“排练室”方式教授莎士比亚，不仅拓展了儿童的词汇量，提升了其写作的复杂程度，也增强了他们的情感素养。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: “The research shows that the way actors work makes a big difference to the way children use language and also how they think about themselves,” Jacqui O’Hanlon of the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC), which commissioned the study, said.
sentences.core: 直接引语的主干是 The research shows that ...；全句的引述结构是 Jacqui O’Hanlon ... said.
sentences.structure: 第一个 that 引导 shows 的宾语从句；the way actors work 是主语，其中省略关系词 that/in which；the way children use language 与 how they think about themselves 并列作介词 to 的宾语；which commissioned the study 补充说明 RSC。
sentences.key: commission：常见义为“委员会；佣金”，此处作动词，意为“委托开展”。；make a big difference to：对……产生显著影响，并非只表示两者“存在差别”。
sentences.zh: 委托开展这项研究的皇家莎士比亚剧团（RSC）的杰姬·奥汉隆说：“研究表明，演员的工作方式会显著影响儿童运用语言的方式，也会影响他们如何看待自己。”
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils — aged nine and ten — at 45 state primary schools that had not been “previously exposed to RSC pedagogy.”
sentences.core: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils.
sentences.structure: 破折号间的 aged nine and ten 补充学生年龄；at 45 state primary schools 说明样本来源；that had not been ... 修饰 schools，实际说明这些学校此前未采用 RSC 教学法。
sentences.key: randomised control trial：随机对照试验，通过随机分组比较干预效果。；be exposed to：接触、经历；此处不含“暴露于危险”的负面意味。；pedagogy：教学法、教育方法。
sentences.zh: 这项随机对照试验涉及 45 所公立小学的数百名五年级学生，他们年龄为九至十岁，此前从未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团的教学法。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: They were split into target and control groups and asked to write, for example, a message in a bottle as Ferdinand following the shipwreck in *The Tempest*.
sentences.core: They were split ... and (were) asked to write ...
sentences.structure: 两个被动谓语由 and 并列；for example 是插入语；as Ferdinand 说明写作者所扮演的身份；following the shipwreck 意为“在海难之后”，修饰写信情境。
sentences.key: target group：此处指接受教学干预的“实验组”，不是市场营销中的“目标群体”。；as Ferdinand：表示“以费迪南德的身份”，体现角色代入，而非“像费迪南德一样”。
sentences.zh: 学生被分为实验组和对照组，并被要求完成写作任务，例如以《暴风雨》中遭遇海难后的费迪南德的身份，写一封装在瓶中的信。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The target group were given a 30-minute drama-based activity to accompany the passage.
sentences.core: The target group were given an activity.
sentences.structure: to accompany the passage 是不定式短语，说明活动与阅读材料配套；该项额外活动构成实验组与对照组之间的教学变量。
sentences.key: drama-based activity：以戏剧表演为基础的活动。；accompany the passage：与该文本配套进行；这里不是“陪伴文章”。
sentences.zh: 实验组还围绕这段文本参加了一项 30 分钟的戏剧活动。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The peer-reviewed results showed that the target group of pupils drew on a wider vocabulary, used words “classed as more sophisticated or rarer”, and wrote at greater length.
sentences.core: The results showed that ...
sentences.structure: that 从句中，drew on、used 和 wrote 是以 the target group of pupils 为共同主语的三个并列谓语，依次呈现词汇范围、用词难度和写作长度三项结果。
sentences.key: peer-reviewed：经过同行评审的。；draw on a wider vocabulary：调动、运用更广泛的词汇。；at greater length：以更长篇幅、更充分地。
sentences.zh: 经同行评审的结果显示，实验组学生使用的词汇范围更广，会采用“被归为更复杂或更少见”的词语，而且写作篇幅也更长。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: They also “appear to be more comfortable writing in role...while [control] pupils imagine how they themselves would react to being shipwrecked, [target] children put themselves in the shoes of a literary character and express that character’s emotion”.
sentences.core: 外层为 They appear to be more comfortable ...；while 从句内是 control pupils imagine ... 与 target children put ... and express ... 的对比。
sentences.structure: how they themselves would react 是 imagine 的宾语从句；to being shipwrecked 中 to 是介词；put 与 express 共用主语 target children。
sentences.key: write in role：以所扮演角色的身份和视角写作。；put oneself in the shoes of：设身处地站在……的立场上。
sentences.zh: 实验组学生似乎也“更能自如地以角色身份写作……对照组学生想象的是自己遭遇海难时会作何反应，而实验组儿童则设身处地代入某个文学人物，并表达该人物的情感”。
sentences.tip: they themselves 指对照组学生本人；实验组表达的是文学人物的情绪，而不是只写自己的反应。

sentences.en: The *Time to Act* study, which is published by the RSC this week, also found that while control pupils relied on “desert island clichés” such as palm trees, target pupils were “more expansive [giving] a broader picture of the sky, the sea and the atmospheric conditions”.
sentences.core: The study also found that ...
sentences.structure: which is published ... 补充说明研究的发布方与时间；that 从句中，while 对照两组学生：对照组依赖套话，实验组能描绘更广泛的环境信息。
sentences.key: expansive：常见义为“广阔的；健谈的”，此处形容描写内容“铺陈更充分、范围更广”。；desert island clichés：关于荒岛的陈词滥调或刻板意象，并非指“荒漠岛屿”。
sentences.zh: 皇家莎士比亚剧团于本周发布的《行动时刻》研究还发现，对照组学生依赖棕榈树之类的“荒岛套话”，而实验组学生的描写则“更加铺陈开阔，[呈现出]天空、海洋和天气状况的更完整画面”。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: O’Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the “emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children’s writing” and that they were “more resilient in their writing, more hopeful”.
sentences.core: O’Hanlon said (that) ... and that ...
sentences.structure: said 后并列两个宾语从句：一是 she had been most surprised by ...，二是 they were ...；that was evident ... 修饰 emotional literacy。
sentences.key: be evident in：在……中清楚地体现出来。；resilient：有韧性的、能从困境中恢复的；此处形容学生笔下人物面对困境的状态。
sentences.zh: 奥汉隆说，最令她惊讶的是“实验组儿童写作中明显体现出的情感素养”，以及他们的文字表现得“更坚韧、更有希望”。
sentences.tip: 第二个 that 与前面省略的宾语从句引导词并列，不是修饰 writing 的定语从句。

sentences.en: She added “The emotional understanding was very evident and it is probably related to the [rehearsal room process] where you are used to trying to imagine your way through.
sentences.core: 引语内是 The emotional understanding was evident and it is related to the process.
sentences.structure: 两个分句由 and 并列；where 引导定语从句，修饰抽象地点式先行词 process；be used to trying 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。
sentences.key: imagine your way through：不是简单“想象出一条路”，而是通过想象进入人物处境，并在头脑中经历整个情境。
sentences.zh: 她补充说：“这种情感理解表现得非常明显，它很可能与‘排练室过程’有关；在这一过程中，学生习惯于凭借想象进入并经历整个情境。
sentences.tip: it 指前面的 emotional understanding，不是指研究本身。

sentences.en: They were comfortable in describing different emotional states and part of what you do in drama is put yourself in different shoes.”
sentences.core: They were comfortable ... and part ... is ...
sentences.structure: and 连接“能够描述情绪”与“戏剧要求角色代入”两层意思；what you do in drama 是 of 的宾语从句；表语位置的 put 与口语表达一致，可理解为 to put。
sentences.key: be comfortable in doing：能够自如、从容地做某事。；put yourself in different shoes：代入不同人物的处境和视角。
sentences.zh: 他们能够自如地描述不同的情绪状态，而戏剧活动的一部分，正是让自己站到不同人物的立场上。”
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: O’Hanlon said more research would be needed but suggested that Shakespeare’s use of 20,000 words, compared with the everyday 2,000 words, gave a “massive expansion of language into children’s lives”, which was combined with children “using their whole bodies to bring words to life”.
sentences.core: O’Hanlon said ... but suggested that Shakespeare’s use ... gave an expansion ...
sentences.structure: said 与 suggested 由 but 连接，既承认仍需研究，又提出判断依据；compared with ... 是插入的比较结构；which was combined with ... 补充说明语言输入与全身参与相结合。
sentences.key: compared with：与……相比；插入句中突出莎士比亚词汇量的优势。；bring words to life：通过动作和表演让词语变得鲜活、可感。；land a scholarly punch：取得有力的学术胜利或获得强有力的研究支持。；make a big difference to：对……产生显著影响。
sentences.zh: 奥汉隆说，这还需要更多研究，但她指出，莎士比亚使用约 20,000 个词，而日常用词仅约 2,000 个，这能让儿童生活中的语言得到“大幅拓展”；与此同时，儿童还会“调动整个身体，让词语鲜活起来”。
sentences.tip: which 回指前面的语言大幅拓展这一效果；它与身体参与相结合，而不是说“20,000 个词”本身在使用身体。

sentences.en: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
sentences.core: I was shocked to learn that ...
sentences.structure: to learn 说明震惊的原因；that 引导 learn 的宾语从句；in an effort to decrease ... 是目的状语，说明一些科学家缩减研究的动机。
sentences.key: scale back：缩减规模、减少投入，不是按某种比例“放大或缩小”。
sentences.zh: 最近得知有些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我深感震惊。
sentences.tip: 作者震惊的是科学家“打算减少研究”，并非他们不愿减少碳排放。

sentences.en: The crisis is here, they said, and we need to cut back on our energy-intensive modelling.
sentences.core: 转述内容是 The crisis is here, and we need to cut back ...
sentences.structure: they said 插在两个并列分句之间，表明这是部分科学家的观点，并非作者立场。
sentences.key: cut back on：削减、减少；与上句的 scale back 同义复现。；energy-intensive modelling：需要消耗大量能源的建模运算。
sentences.zh: 他们说，危机已经来临，我们必须减少高耗能的建模工作。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: It is unarguable that our laboratories, scientific instruments, rockets and satellites — the tools we scientists need to measure the planet’s pulse — demand significant amounts of energy both in their construction and operation.
sentences.core: It is unarguable that our laboratories ... demand significant amounts of energy.
sentences.structure: It 是形式主语，that 从句是真正主语；破折号之间的名词短语同位解释前列各类科研工具，其中 we scientists need 是省略关系词的定语从句；both ... and ... 并列两个耗能阶段。
sentences.key: measure the planet’s pulse：字面为“测量地球的脉搏”，此处比喻持续监测地球环境和气候状态。；unarguable：无可争辩的、不容否认的。；both in their construction and operation：在建造和运行两个阶段都……。
sentences.zh: 无可争辩的是，我们的实验室、科学仪器、火箭和卫星——这些是科学家监测地球“脉搏”所必需的工具——无论在建造阶段还是运行阶段，都需要消耗大量能源。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: And it is equally true that science’s unrelenting appetite for information has caused a mushrooming of energy-intensive data centres around the world.
sentences.core: It is equally true that ...
sentences.structure: 形式主语结构中，science’s unrelenting appetite for information 是 that 从句的主语；has caused a mushrooming of ... 表示这一需求导致数据中心激增。
sentences.key: appetite：常见义为“食欲”，此处比喻对信息的强烈需求。；mushrooming：像蘑菇般迅速增多，即“激增、涌现”。
sentences.zh: 同样不可否认的是，科学对信息永无止境的需求，导致高耗能数据中心在世界各地迅速涌现。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: However, this is a price we must pay for understanding the world.
sentences.core: This is a price.
sentences.structure: we must pay 是省略关系代词 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 price；for understanding the world 说明付出代价所换取的目标。
sentences.key: price：此处并非货币价格，而是为获得科研认识而承担的能源和碳排放成本。
sentences.zh: 然而，这是我们为了认识世界而必须付出的代价。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can’t track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it’s coming from and who’s producing it?
sentences.core: How can we inform decision makers ...?
sentences.structure: if 引导条件从句；the amount ...、where ... 和 who ... 并列作 track 的宾语，分别对应排放量、排放来源和排放主体。
sentences.key: inform decision makers about：向决策者提供有关……的信息。；bring down carbon emissions：降低碳排放。；track：持续追踪、监测。
sentences.zh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中二氧化碳的总量、来源以及排放者，又怎能向决策者说明减少碳排放的最佳方式呢？
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
sentences.core: 冒号前为 The carbon emissions ... are well spent，冒号后为 this research will safeguard ...。
sentences.structure: 见原句
sentences.key: well spent：通常修饰时间或金钱，表示“花得值得”；此处把碳排放视为换取长期收益的一项成本。
sentences.zh: 技术研究产生的这些碳排放是值得付出的：归根结底，这类研究将守护我们星球的未来。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation.
sentences.core: It can be hard for scientists to make the case.
sentences.structure: It 是形式主语，to make the case 是真正主语；because 从句中，is complex、takes place 和 does not lend itself 是以 our work 为共同主语的三个并列谓语。
sentences.key: make the case：提出充分理由、令人信服地论证，此处指向公众说明科研的价值。；behind closed doors：字面为“在紧闭的门后”，此处指不为公众所见、缺少公开可见性。；lend itself to：适合于、易于接受某种处理。
sentences.zh: 科学家有时很难把这一道理讲清楚，因为我们的工作十分复杂，往往在公众视野之外进行，也并不总是容易理解或解释。
sentences.tip: interpretation or explanation 不是科学工作本身不可靠，而是其复杂性使公众不容易理解，也使科学家不容易说明。

sentences.en: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity’s greatest challenges.
sentences.core: Demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial.
sentences.structure: 动名词短语作主语；if 从句给出目标和必要条件。
sentences.key: efficacy：功效、实际效力，强调能否产生预期结果。；if we are to do：如果我们要做到……；常含“这是实现目标所必需的”意味。
sentences.zh: 但如果人类要解决最重大的难题，证明科学确有成效将至关重要。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: It is all too easy to feel paralysed in the face of daunting problems such as climate change and to do nothing.
sentences.core: It is all too easy to feel ... and to do nothing.
sentences.structure: It 为形式主语，两个并列不定式 to feel 和 to do 是真正主语；in the face of 引出造成无力感的困境。
sentences.key: all too easy：实在太容易发生，常暗示某种令人遗憾的倾向。；paralysed：本义为“瘫痪的”，此处指因恐惧或问题艰巨而无法行动。
sentences.zh: 面对气候变化等令人生畏的难题，人很容易陷入无力感，最终什么也不做。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: But then I think of a friend’s daughter who turned her fears into action: she became a wind energy engineer and now thrives on delivering renewable energy, limiting emissions.
sentences.core: 冒号前为 I think of a friend’s daughter，冒号后为 she became ... and now thrives ...。
sentences.structure: who turned ... 修饰 daughter；冒号后的事例说明她采取了什么行动；limiting emissions 补充说明输送可再生能源所产生的结果。
sentences.key: turn one’s fears into action：把恐惧转化为行动。；thrive on doing：因做某事而充满活力、获得成长与满足。
sentences.zh: 但这时，我会想到一位朋友的女儿。她把恐惧转化成了行动：她成为一名风能工程师，如今投身于输送可再生能源、限制碳排放，并从中获得成长与满足。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Recognising the hope that science and engineering can bring was the impetus behind the creation of the Millennium Technology Prize, which is now entering its 20th year as a celebration of human ingenuity.
sentences.core: Recognising the hope ... was the impetus ...
sentences.structure: 动名词 Recognising 引出的短语作主语；that science and engineering can bring 修饰 hope；which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 the Millennium Technology Prize。
sentences.key: impetus：推动力、促成某事发生的动力。；enter its 20th year：进入第 20 个年头，并非已经满 20 周年。
sentences.zh: 认识到科学与工程能够带来希望，正是设立“千年技术奖”的推动力；如今，该奖项即将迈入第 20 个年头，持续礼赞人类的创造才智。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world’s solar panels.
sentences.core: One of the past winners is the inventor of the technology.
sentences.structure: 两个逗号之间是 One of the past winners 的同位语；which is now found ... 修饰 PERC 技术，而不是修饰发明者。
sentences.key: past winner：往届获奖者。；be found in：存在于、应用于；此处表示该技术得到广泛采用。
sentences.zh: 该奖项往届得主之一、澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的马丁·格林教授，是“钝化发射极和背面电池”（PERC）技术的发明者；如今，全球大多数太阳能电池板都采用了这项技术。
sentences.tip: 格林获奖只是人物背景，例子的论证重点在其发明被广泛应用并产生减排价值。

sentences.en: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence.
sentences.core: Scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways and develop techniques.
sentences.structure: to exploit ... 修饰 ways；not just to use ... but to power ... 是并列不定式，说明所开发技术的双重用途。
sentences.key: exploit：常见义为“剥削”，此处意为“开发、利用（资源）”，不含贬义。；power our intelligence：利用电力驱动承载人类智力活动的计算系统，与前面的 use power more intelligently 构成文字游戏。
sentences.zh: 科学家、技术专家和工程师每天都在探索利用可再生能源的新方式，并开发各种技术，不仅让我们更聪明地使用电力，也用电力驱动人类的智能运算。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: A great example of this is Europe’s largest supercomputer, LUMI in Finland, which is astonishingly carbon-negative.
sentences.core: A great example of this is ... LUMI.
sentences.structure: LUMI in Finland 是 Europe’s largest supercomputer 的同位语；which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充其负碳特征。
sentences.key: carbon-negative：负碳的，即其运行及相关安排所减少或抵消的碳排放超过自身产生的排放。
sentences.zh: 这方面的杰出范例是位于芬兰、欧洲规模最大的超级计算机 LUMI；令人惊叹的是，它实现了“负碳排放”。
sentences.tip: this 回指上一句所说的可再生能源利用与可持续计算技术，而不是单指“人类智能”。

sentences.en: Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
sentences.core: It is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people.
sentences.structure: Established in an old paper mill 是过去分词短语，补充 LUMI 的设置地点；who live ... 修饰 the people。
sentences.key: be powered by：由……提供动力或电力。；surrounding town：周边城镇。
sentences.zh: LUMI 建在一座旧造纸厂内，由附近河流提供电力，其远程供热还为周边卡亚尼镇的居民送去温暖。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: If the world is to meet its net-zero ambitions, we must think hard about how we can deliver sustainable computing and deliver more LUMIs.
sentences.core: We must think hard about how ...
sentences.structure: If the world is to ... 给出实现净零目标的条件；how 引导介词 about 的宾语从句；两个 deliver 并列，分别指实现可持续计算和推广 LUMI 模式。
sentences.key: meet its net-zero ambitions：实现其净零排放目标。；deliver sustainable computing：落实、实现可持续计算。；deliver more LUMIs：建设、复制更多 LUMI 式系统，不是“运送更多计算机”。；scale back research：缩减研究规模。
sentences.zh: 如果世界要实现净零排放目标，我们就必须认真思考如何推动可持续计算，并建设更多像 LUMI 这样的超级计算机。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
sentences.core: Old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming.
sentences.structure: Ever since taking on ... 是时间状语；with + 名词 + 现在分词 构成伴随结构，说明多个平台持续亏损；sparking ... 是结果状语；that 引导 concerns 的同位语从句。
sentences.key: take on ... at its own game：在对方擅长的领域与之竞争或较量。；old Hollywood：不是“古老的好莱坞”，而是相对于科技流媒体平台而言的传统影视制片业。；turn a profit：实现盈利、开始赚取利润。；the likes of：诸如……之类的人或事物。
sentences.zh: 自从传统好莱坞在网飞擅长的流媒体领域与之正面竞争以来，它始终难以从流媒体业务中获利；迪士尼+、Peacock 和 Paramount+ 等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，由此引发担忧：这些服务可能永远无法达到传统有线电视昔日的盈利水平。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
sentences.core: The age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners.
sentences.structure: 冒号后的 pirates 解释“意外赢家”；that use ... and host ... 包含两个并列谓语；which rake in ... 修饰离它最近的 illegitimate services。
sentences.key: boon：带来便利或利益的事物、福音。；rip：此处指从数字平台快速抓取、复制影音内容，不是普通的“撕裂”。；title：此处指一部电影或电视节目，而不是“标题”。；host the titles：托管、上线这些影视内容。
sentences.zh: 然而，流媒体时代却让一群意料之外的赢家获益匪浅：盗版者用软件在数秒内从正规在线视频平台抓取电影或电视剧，再把这些作品放到自己的非法服务平台上；这些平台每年通过广告和订阅收入约 20 亿美元。
sentences.tip: 年入 20 亿美元的是盗版服务，不是被窃取内容的正规视频平台。

sentences.en: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that’s working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
sentences.core: Illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%.
sentences.structure: With no video production costs 是原因背景；according to ... 引出信息来源；a trade group ... 是 MPA 的同位语，其中 representing ... 修饰 group，that’s working ... 进一步说明该协会的行动，末尾 that have cropped up ... 修饰 platforms。
sentences.key: margin：此处指“利润率”，不是页面边距或差距。；crop up：突然出现、大量涌现。；crack down on：严厉打击、制裁。；trade group：行业协会。
sentences.zh: 美国电影协会（MPA）表示，由于无需承担视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近 90%。该协会是代表好莱坞制片公司的行业组织，正努力打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
sentences.core: The rise of legitimate online businesses helped curb digital piracy.
sentences.structure: such as Netflix 举例说明正规在线业务；which had ... been based on file uploads 补充说明当时盗版的主要形式。
sentences.key: curb：作动词意为“遏制、抑制”，不是路边的“马路牙子”。；be based on file uploads：以文件上传和分享为主要传播方式。
sentences.zh: 起初，网飞等正规在线业务的兴起实际上帮助遏制了数字盗版；此前，数字盗版主要依赖文件上传。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center.
sentences.core: Piracy costs the US economy about $30 billion ... and some 250,000 jobs.
sentences.structure: involving ... 修饰 piracy；cost + 对象 + 损失 表示“使某方损失……”；句末 estimates ... 是倒装式引述语，说明数据来源。
sentences.key: as well as：除……之外还……，此处连接非法流媒体和文件分享两种盗版形式。；lost revenue：损失的收入。
sentences.zh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件分享的盗版行为，每年使美国经济损失约 300 亿美元收入和约 25 万个就业岗位。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: “The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations,” says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA.
sentences.core: 引语内为 The people ... are not mom and pop operations.
sentences.structure: who 引导定语从句，其中 are stealing 与 operating 并列，说明这些人的两类行为；逗号后的 chief executive officer ... 是 Rivkin 的同位语。
sentences.key: mom and pop operations：夫妻或家庭经营的小型企业，此处泛指零散、规模很小的盗版者。
sentences.zh: 美国电影协会首席执行官查理·里夫金说：“那些盗取我们的电影和电视节目、经营盗版网站的人，并不是什么家庭式小作坊。”
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy.
sentences.core: Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed ...
sentences.structure: five years earlier 以 2017 年为参照，指五年前；to build consensus between ... 接在 failed 后说明失败事项；后一个 to win passage ... 表示凝聚共识的目的；aimed at stopping ... 修饰 legislation。
sentences.key: build consensus：凝聚共识、促成各方达成一致。；win passage of legislation：争取使一项法案获得通过；passage 此处不是“文章段落”。
sentences.zh: 里夫金于 2017 年加入美国电影协会；五年前，该协会曾试图在好莱坞与硅谷之间凝聚共识，以推动国会通过打击网络盗版的立法，但最终未能成功。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.
sentences.core: The association formed ACE.
sentences.structure: an enforcement task force ... 是 ACE 的同位语；circling the globe 修饰 detectives；to help ... arrest ... 说明调查人员全球行动的目的。
sentences.key: enforcement task force：专门负责执法行动的工作组。；circle the globe：在世界各地奔走、开展行动。；local authorities：当地执法或政府部门。
sentences.zh: 2017 年，该协会成立了“创意与娱乐联盟”（ACE）。这是一支执法工作组，约有 100 名调查人员在全球开展行动，协助当地执法部门逮捕流媒体盗版者。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: ACE says it’s helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA’s support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyright material a serious crime.
sentences.core: ACE says (that) it has helped shrink the number ...
sentences.structure: to 126 表示减少后的数量，from more than 1,400 表示起点；aided in part by ... 是过去分词短语，补充说明这一降幅的助力；that made ... 修饰 a 2020 federal law。
sentences.key: shrink ... to ..., from ...：把……从某一数量减少到另一数量。；copyright material：受版权保护的内容。；a serious crime：严重犯罪。
sentences.zh: ACE 表示，它已帮助把北美非法流媒体服务的数量从 2018 年的 1,400 多个压缩至 126 个；这一成果也部分得益于美国电影协会对 2020 年一项联邦法律的支持，该法律把大规模传播版权内容的流媒体盗版行为列为严重犯罪。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services’ cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
sentences.core: Parks Associates predicts that the cumulative loss ... will reach $113 billion.
sentences.structure: that 引导宾语从句；legitimate US streaming services’ 是所有格，说明损失承担者；from piracy 说明损失来源；since 2022 是累计起点。
sentences.key: cumulative loss：累计损失。；loss from piracy：盗版造成的损失。
sentences.zh: 咨询公司 Parks Associates 预测，从 2022 年开始累计计算，未来两年美国正规流媒体服务因盗版造成的损失将达到 1,130 亿美元。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: “While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline,” says analyst Steve Hawley.
sentences.core: 让步从句为 While there is some optimism ...，主句为 there is no consensus ...。
sentences.structure: 第一个 that 说明乐观预期的内容；as to when ... 说明各方缺乏共识的问题；it 回指 piracy。
sentences.key: plateau：作动词意为“进入平台期、停止增长”，不等于“开始下降”。；see piracy begin to plateau：这里的 see 表示“促成、见证某种结果出现”，主语是应对措施和最佳实践。；countermeasure：应对措施、反制手段。；stakeholder：利益相关方。
sentences.zh: 分析师史蒂夫·霍利说：“尽管有人乐观地认为，新出现的应对措施和最佳实践或许能让盗版活动到 2027 年开始趋于平稳，但利益相关方对于它究竟何时才会开始下降，并没有一致看法。”
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World’s Fair, the ephemera of history.
sentences.core: Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past.
sentences.structure: 祈使句 + and + 陈述句 表示“只要……就……”；冒号后的照片、书信和宣传册列举 artifacts；detailing ... 修饰 a brochure；末尾 the ephemera of history 概括前述物件。
sentences.key: artifact：人工制品；在历史与档案语境中指承载过去信息的实物资料。；ephemera：原本只供短期使用、不打算长期保存的印刷品或物件，如传单、票据和宣传册。
sentences.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会遇见来自过去的物件：照片、书信、一份介绍 1964-1965 年世界博览会辛克莱恐龙展的宣传册——这些都是历史上原本短暂易逝的资料。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Yet these objects aren’t truly ephemeral, because they’re still here, decades, even centuries later.
sentences.core: These objects aren’t truly ephemeral.
sentences.structure: because 引导原因从句；decades, even centuries later 是时间状语，even 递进强调保存时间之长。
sentences.key: ephemeral：短暂的、转瞬即逝的；与上句名词 ephemera 构成词形复现和语义反转。
sentences.zh: 然而，这些物件其实并非真正转瞬即逝，因为几十年、甚至几百年后，它们依然存在。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?
sentences.core: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats?
sentences.structure: digital information 是 intangible formats 的同位解释；given that 意为“考虑到、鉴于”，引导原因背景；who produce these artifacts 修饰 those。
sentences.key: life cycle：此处指数字格式从产生、使用到过时失效的完整周期。；make provision for：为……预先安排或采取准备措施。
sentences.zh: 既然数字资料的制作者很少为其长期保存预作安排，你是否思考过这类无形格式，也就是数字信息，究竟有怎样的生命周期？
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: For millennia, we’ve known what we’ve known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators’ neglect.
sentences.core: We’ve known what we’ve known due to artifacts.
sentences.structure: what we’ve known 是 known 的宾语从句；that have survived 修饰 artifacts；despite their original creators’ neglect 表示让步。
sentences.key: we’ve known what we’ve known：并非无意义重复，而是强调人类既有的历史知识依赖幸存实物。
sentences.zh: 数千年来，我们之所以能够了解过去，靠的是那些留存至今的实物；它们往往是在最初制作者疏于保存的情况下仍然幸存下来的。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information.
sentences.core: The thing itself is the medium.
sentences.structure: that delivers the information 修饰 medium；itself 强调实物和信息载体合而为一。
sentences.key: medium：信息的载体、媒介；media 是其复数形式之一。
sentences.zh: 实体物本身就是传递信息的媒介。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
sentences.core: No attempts were made ..., yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as ...
sentences.structure: yet 连接转折；surviving 与 serving 并列作介词 of 的宾语；that ... rely on 修饰 historical record，关系代词在从句中作 on 的宾语。
sentences.key: intentional preservation：有意识、有计划的保存。；analog materials：模拟材料，指纸张、胶片等以实体形式连续记录信息的材料。；serve as：充当、用作。
sentences.zh: 这些资料产生之初，人们并未尝试有意保存它们；然而，模拟材料仍有机会留存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
sentences.tip: their original creators’ neglect 并不意味着实体资料不会损坏，只表示它们即使缺乏主动保存也仍有自然幸存的可能。

sentences.en: Thus, librarians digitize the tangible so that researchers the world over can quickly search and access their holdings.
sentences.core: Librarians digitize the tangible.
sentences.structure: the tangible 是“the + 形容词”结构，泛指有形资料；so that 引导目的兼结果从句；search 与 access 并列。
sentences.key: holdings：图书馆、档案馆或博物馆所收藏的资料，即“馆藏”。；the world over：遍及全世界、世界各地。
sentences.zh: 因此，图书馆员把实体资料数字化，使世界各地的研究者都能快速检索并获取馆藏内容。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The result is an embarrassment of historical riches, which brings its own needle-and-haystack problems.
sentences.core: The result is an embarrassment of historical riches.
sentences.structure: which 引导非限制性定语从句，回指资料异常丰富这一结果；its own 强调丰富资源也会产生新的检索问题。
sentences.key: an embarrassment of riches：好东西多到难以选择，即“多得令人应接不暇”，不是“财富带来的羞耻”。；needle-and-haystack problems：在海量信息中寻找特定资料的“大海捞针”难题。
sentences.zh: 其结果是历史资料丰富得令人不知如何取舍，而这种富足也带来了大海捞针般的检索难题。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Librarians’ selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cellphone and saying, “it’s all in here” as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
sentences.core: Librarians’ selfless devotion can act against us.
sentences.structure: when 引导出现负面效果的情境；by holding up ... and saying ... 说明用户如何表达看法；as evidence that ... 中 that 从句说明这一“证据”被用来证明什么。
sentences.key: act against us：产生对我们不利的效果；us 指作者所属的图书馆员群体。；universality of access：信息获取的普遍可达性，即人们似乎随时随地都能取得信息。；vital：至关重要的、不可或缺的。
sentences.zh: 图书馆员无私投入所创造的便利有时反而会对我们不利：用户举起手机说“这里面什么都有”，用普遍可获取的信息作为证据，认为今天的研究者已经不再那么需要图书馆。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?
sentences.core: 两个并列疑问是 How was that universality made possible? 和 How is it maintained?
sentences.structure: perhaps more importantly 是插入语；it 回指 that universality of access。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 然而，这种普遍可获取性究竟是如何实现的？也许更重要的是，它又是如何维持的？
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Who curates what is preserved?
sentences.core: 见结构
sentences.structure: what is preserved 是 curates 的宾语从句，意为“被保存的内容”。
sentences.key: curate：在档案语境中指依照专业标准选择、组织和管理资料，不只是策划展览。
sentences.zh: 又是谁在筛选和整理那些被保存下来的内容？
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Digital information requires a great deal more care than analog.
sentences.core: 见结构
sentences.structure: a great deal 修饰比较级 more；analog 省略了上文已有的 information/materials。
sentences.key: care：此处不是“关心”，而是为确保信息持续可读而进行的维护、迁移和管理。
sentences.zh: 数字信息需要投入的维护远多于模拟资料。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Even when a digital object is preserved, it may only be the carrier that’s saved, not the information itself.
sentences.core: It may only be the carrier that’s saved, not the information itself.
sentences.structure: Even when 引导让步从句；主句使用近似强调结构，that’s saved 强调实际留下的可能只是载体；not 引出被排除的信息本身。
sentences.key: carrier：承载数字信息的物理介质，如磁盘或磁带。；saved：此处既有“保存下来”之意，也呼应计算机中的“存储”；载体仍在不等于其中的信息仍可读取。
sentences.zh: 即便一个数字对象被保存下来，留存的也可能只是存储载体，而不是信息本身。
sentences.tip: it 指 a digital object；“保存了数字对象”在表面上成立，却可能没有保存其可访问的信息内容。

sentences.en: As technology advances and a format becomes obsolete, the object is useless.
sentences.core: 见结构
sentences.structure: As 表示“随着”；从句中 technology advances 与 a format becomes obsolete 并列，主句给出结果。
sentences.key: become obsolete：变得过时、被淘汰。
sentences.zh: 随着技术发展、某种格式遭到淘汰，这个数字对象也就失去了用处。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?
sentences.core: Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk?
sentences.structure: thinking 是伴随状语；冒号后的直接疑问说明看到旧磁盘时的具体困境。
sentences.key: get the files off：把文件从旧介质中读取、导出，而不是把文件“从上面拿下来”。；ZIP disk：20 世纪 90 年代流行的可移动磁盘，需要专用 ZIP 驱动器读取，后来随硬件和格式淘汰而难以使用。
sentences.zh: 你是否曾无助地盯着一张 ZIP 磁盘，心里想着：我怎样才能把里面的文件取出来？
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replace analog.
sentences.core: A nightmare ... is what keeps historians up at night.
sentences.structure: Without ... 给出否定条件；what keeps historians up at night 是表语从句；冒号后的 a historical record ... 同位解释噩梦的具体内容；that abruptly stops ... 修饰 record。
sentences.key: migration of digital assets：把数字资料持续转移到新的格式、介质或系统中，以保持其可读取性。；keep someone up at night：让某人忧心忡忡、夜不能寐。
sentences.zh: 如果不持续迁移数字资料，历史学家就会被一种关于可见未来的噩梦搅得夜不能寐：当数字资料取代模拟资料后，历史记录会突然中断。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I’d be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
sentences.core: I share the night terrors ..., and I’d be lying ...
sentences.structure: 句首 As a librarian ... 说明作者身份；whose day job ... 修饰 librarian；if I said ... 是条件从句，以虚拟式表达对“已有全面方案”的否定。
sentences.key: revolve around：以……为中心、主要围绕……展开。；I’d be lying if I said ...：委婉而有力地承认某事并不成立，即“要说……存在，那并不真实”。；special collections：图书馆中具有稀缺性、历史价值或特殊载体形式的特藏资料。；comprehensive preservation solution：覆盖各种数字格式与长期需求的全面保存方案。
sentences.zh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏资料与数字资产展开的图书馆员，我同样承受着历史学家的这种夜间恐惧；如果我说目前已经存在一套全面的保存方案，那就是在撒谎。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing, and preserving digital information for researchers current and future.
sentences.core: Researchers can take some comfort in the fact.
sentences.structure: that 引导同位语从句，解释 the fact；devoted to ... 修饰 librarians；discovering、organizing 和 preserving 并列；current and future 后置修饰 researchers。
sentences.key: take comfort in：从……中得到安慰。；a multitude of：大量、众多。；be devoted to doing：致力于做某事，to 为介词。
sentences.zh: 不过，研究者仍可从一个事实中得到些许安慰：众多图书馆员正致力于发现、整理和保存数字信息，为当下及未来的研究者服务。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Librarians are uniquely positioned to understand how end users seek and use information.
sentences.core: 见结构
sentences.structure: how end users seek and use information 是 understand 的宾语从句，其中 seek 与 use 并列。
sentences.key: be uniquely positioned to do：因自身角色、经验或资源而特别适合做某事，并非指物理位置。；end users：信息系统或服务的最终使用者。
sentences.zh: 图书馆员处在独特而有利的位置，能够理解终端用户如何查找并使用信息。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Thus we play an integral role in identifying, preserving, and providing accessibility to digital artifacts so that, while future researchers may find the digital realm a challenging place to ply their trade, they won’t find it an impossible one.
sentences.core: We play an integral role ... so that ... they won’t find it an impossible one.
sentences.structure: 三个动名词 identifying、preserving、providing 并列作介词 in 的宾语；so that 引导结果从句，其中嵌入 while 让步从句；find + 宾语 + 宾补 在两处分別为 find the digital realm a challenging place 与 find it an impossible one。
sentences.key: integral：不可或缺的、构成整体所必需的，不是“完整的”。；ply one’s trade：从事本职工作；此处指研究者开展研究。；provide accessibility to：使……可被获取和利用。；digital realm：数字领域、数字信息环境。
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在识别、保存数字资料并使其可供利用方面发挥着不可或缺的作用；这样一来，未来的研究者即使会觉得数字世界是一个颇具挑战的研究场域，也不至于发现它根本无法开展工作。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。
